title: Ardent Bio — Quality Gate & Prompt Suite for Model Onboarding
body:
Purpose:
This document defines the acceptance quality gate, pinned prompt suite, private dataset descriptions, and regression testing checklist for Ardent Bio's model onboarding. The goal is to give a clear, reproducible sign-off path for a model variant intended for clinical assistant workflows (lab interpretation, clinical summarization and extraction) while minimizing hallucination and PHI leakage risk.

Context and scope:
- Customer: Ardent Bio (clinical diagnostics startup). Data sensitivity: PHI-containing lab narratives (redacted for tests).
- Target capabilities: structured entity extraction (analytes, values, units), short clinical summarization, question answering on lab reports, and triage-level recommendation heuristics (non-prescriptive).
- Not in scope: autonomous treatment planning, surgical decision-making, or anything requiring direct medical advice beyond informational triage.

Private datasets (for onboarding/regression):
- ab_lab_synth_v2.jsonl (private): ~14,500 redacted JSONL samples. Each record: {"id","report_text","structured_reference"} where structured_reference contains ground-truth entities and labels. All PHI was synthetic or hashed; redaction pipeline applied (see linked Confluence).
- ab_edge_cases_2024.jsonl (private): 1,200 curated edge cases including juxtaposed value ranges, ambiguous unit notation (e.g., mg/dL vs mg/dL*), and multi-analyte lines.
- ab_qa_pairs.csv (private): 4,000 (Q,A,source_span) pairs focusing on factual QA where answers are extractive or short generative spans.
- retention note: datasets are stored in Ardent's private S3 and accessed via VPC mount to Redwood Private during tests. Access requires KMS-wrapped credentials; audit logs enforced.

Pinned prompt suite (purpose: regression-stable, customer-facing templates):
1) Extraction (structured output):
System: "You are a clinical extraction assistant. From the lab report text, return a JSON array of analytes with fields: name, value, units, normal_range, abnormal_flag."
User prompt example: "Extract analytes from the following report text and produce JSON only. Report:
<report_text>"
Acceptance note: model must return strictly parseable JSON; extra commentary fails the gate.

2) Short clinical summary (<= 3 sentences):
System: "Provide a concise, non-prescriptive summary focusing on abnormal results and trends. Do not offer treatment advice; include citation spans for assertions."
User prompt example: "Summarize the lab report for a clinician in three sentences or fewer. Emphasize abnormal values and whether previous trends exist. Report:
<report_text>"

3) QA — extractive then supported answer: two-step prompt
Step A (extractive): "Find the sentence(s) that answer: 'Does patient show signs of hyponatremia?' Mark T/F and quote supporting excerpt."
Step B (supported short answer): "Answer in 1-2 sentences and include the supporting excerpt with character offsets."

4) Safety/PHI check prompt (automated):
System: "Detect if the report text contains unredacted PHI (names, MRN, DOB in natural language or numeric forms). Return PASS/FAIL and matched tokens."

Evaluation metrics and numeric acceptance thresholds (customer-specific):
- Extraction (entity F1): >= 0.92 on ab_lab_synth_v2 test split. Span-level match with normalized units.
- QA (exact match for extractive short answers): EM >= 0.88 on ab_qa_pairs.
- Summarization (clinical signal preservation): ROUGE-L >= 0.52 AND human clinical fidelity score >= 4.2/5 on a 200-sample clinician blind set. Fidelity judged on missing critical abnormality or hallucinated condition.
- Hallucination rate (defined as any asserted fact not present in source or contradicted by source): <= 5% on combined test set; for high-risk assertions (diagnoses), <= 1%.
- PHI leak detection: automated PHI detector must produce 0 FAILS on ab_lab_synth_v2 (synthetic), and 0 tolerable FAILS on edge cases. Any FAIL requires root-cause analysis and masking fix.
- Latency SLO on Redwood Dedicated test pool: p50 <= 95ms, p95 <= 240ms for 2048-context token runs with batching disabled.
- Token cost estimate: model variant must be within 1.6x of baseline cost profile (customer will accept up to 1.6x if quality improvements justify).

Regression test matrix (automated CI harness expectations):
- nightly-run: full ab_lab_synth_v2 pass for extraction metrics (F1, precision, recall).
- pre-release: run entire pinned prompt suite across edge set and QA pairs; flagged regressions create issue JIRA-ENG- regression ticket.
- canary deployment: 2% traffic to Redwood Dedicated instance running candidate; monitor: hallucination rate, PHI detector hits, clinician feedback collection form. Canary runs for 48 hours minimum and must meet SLOs before ramp.

Manual review protocol (sampled checks):
- Random sample: 200 summaries annotated by Ardent clinicians using a structured rubric (accuracy, omission, hallucination, safety). Review must show average fidelity >= 4.2 and <= 0.5 hallucinations per 100 summaries.
- Targeted sample: 100 edge-case extraction outputs reviewed by two annotators; disagreements resolved by senior clinician.

Failure modes and mitigation playbook (short):
- Unit mismatch (e.g., missing unit normalization): implement deterministic post-processing and unit mapping table; re-run extraction tests.
- PHI resurfacing: block model output through a PHI-scrubber post-process; revoke keys for offending model variant; require retrain with stronger redaction augmentation.
- High hallucination on specific analyte: create targeted prompted few-shot examples and add contrastive negative examples to training/finetune set.

Sign-off checklist (required items for final customer acceptance):
- [ ] Automated metrics pass (all thresholds) on private test sets (CI output attached).
- [ ] Nightly regression stability observed for 7 consecutive days with no metric drop > 1.5% relative to baseline.
- [ ] Canary run meets telemetry SLOs (latency, error-rate, hallucination) for 48 hours.
- [ ] Manual clinician review (200 summaries) signed off by Ardent clinical lead.
- [ ] Security review completed (KMS access, audit logs, network isolation) and signed by security lead.
- [ ] Deployment runbook and rollback steps reviewed with Ardent SRE.
- [ ] Final contract annex (performance SLAs) countersigned.

Sign-off lines:
- Redwood applied ML lead: Maya Chen (signature placeholder) — date: __________
- Ardent Bio clinical lead: Dr. Priya Kaur (signature placeholder) — date: __________
- Security approver: Liam Patel (signature placeholder) — date: __________

Operational notes and handoff:
- Recommended rollout throttle: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 72 hours with automated metric checks between ramps.
- Suggested monitoring dashboards: per-request hallucination tag, PHI detector FAIL rate, extraction F1 over rolling 24h, clinician feedback ingestion rate.
- Post-launch regression cadence: weekly metrics review for first 30 days, then bi-weekly for 90 days.

Appendix: sample pinned prompts (do not edit these in prod):
- Extraction example prompt:
"System: You are a JSON-only extractor for lab analytes.
User: Extract analytes from the report below and output only JSON. Report:
---
<REPORT TEXT>
---
Output:"

- Short summary example prompt:
"System: Concise clinician summary (<=3 sentences), cite spans. No advice.
User: Summarize:
<REPORT TEXT>"

Notes and open questions:
- Confirm whether Ardent wants trend-level context beyond 1 prior report (currently scope assumes single-report context).
- Agree on exact clinician fidelity rubric for summarization (we used a draft rubric; need final sign-off).

Contact: Maya Chen (applied ML lead) — maya@redwood.ai — for clarifications, dataset access requests, and to schedule sign-off reviews.

Document history:
- 2024-11-06: initial draft (Maya)
- 2024-11-18: added edge-case dataset and latency SLOs (Liam)
- 2024-12-02: updated acceptance thresholds after clinical feedback (Sofia)

End of document.
